classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: one cell per included preview state-class (Rebuildable cache/index, Operational metadata) and per lifecycle operation in the slash-joined set {migration, backup, purge, recovery}, on each D-002 platform. Each cell retains the seven first-group live-cell members for that class × operation, bound to that class's declared owner and writer. Authoritative evidence is not a cell. Analysis-affecting durable state is not a cell. A sealed-Run class is not a cell. Purge cells retain declaration and in-class scope only; they do not author a purge recipe, D9 code, exit number, or PURGED typed result. Migration and recovery cells retain in-class declaration; they do not author G18 journal write/fsync/rename/pointer crash corpus or G11 custody recovery. Backup cells retain class-preserving backup/restore declaration; they do not author storage-mechanics recipes. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Every included-class × {migration, backup, purge, recovery} cell is present on all four D-002 platforms. A skipped class, operation, or platform is not a waiver. OUT classes are not cells. Windows is not a cell. G12, G18, and G11 are not scored.

classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: per D-002 platform, digest-pinned refused writes among the two included classes and from either included class toward Authoritative evidence, covering file 04's four named negative tests as they apply to preview classes: cross-class writes, cache-to-authority promotion, undeclared Plan inputs, and component evidence commits. A cache or operational-metadata byte is not treated as sealed evidence. A preview analyze terminal result labeled a sealed Run is G27 and is not this class. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: A writer of one included class cannot commit into the other included class's store. Neither included class becomes Authoritative evidence by copy, rename, or citation. An undeclared Plan input fails. A component evidence commit fails. Treating cache or operational metadata as sealed evidence fails. G27 is not scored. Pass all four D-002 platforms.
